verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity supports webhook events on verification-status changes, letting developers build custom automated reactions (e.g., approve/reject downstream flows), and review tools offer some rule-like actions (override status, blocklist). However, this is developer-implemented event handling rather than a built-in, user-configurable rules engine for defining conditional triggers/actions declaratively. Missing for 10: a native no-code/declarative rules engine, conditional trigger logic beyond simple status-change webhooks, and AI-agent-specific automation hooks beyond the general MCP server.
